project_type: Next.js 14 (App Router) + React 18 + TypeScript + PostgreSQL + Prisma
build_system: Next.js with npm. Uses Prisma for database migrations. All dependencies installed via npm.
test_framework: Vitest with jsdom for unit tests. Integration tests use vitest.integration.config.ts. Test files in tests/ directory.
test_command: npm run test (unit) or npm run test:all (unit + integration)
verification_instructions: Run npm run verify which executes: prisma generate && tsc --noEmit && next lint && vitest run && next build. Each feature should be verified with both unit tests and manual testing where applicable.
snapshot_or_generated_files: prisma/migrations/ generated by prisma migrate dev. Prisma Client regenerated by prisma generate (runs on postinstall). .next/ build output is NOT checked in.
environment_constraints: PostgreSQL must be running. Redis and Pusher are optional (graceful degradation). Email service (Resend) is optional. Never restart dev server running on port 3000. All new env vars must be added to .env.example AND lib/env.ts validation schema.
contribution_requirements: TypeScript strict mode. Server-only code must import 'server-only' at top. All database queries via Prisma. All user inputs validated with Zod schemas. Follow existing service layer patterns (services/*.ts). API routes in app/api/**/route.ts. Auth required for all non-public routes. Use AuthUser from lib/auth/rbac for permission checks. Audit sensitive actions via audit-service.ts.
key_patterns: Services layer pattern: import 'server-only'; export async functions; use db from @/lib/db; validate with Zod; return typed results. API routes: export GET/POST/etc; validate input; call service; return NextResponse. Components: 'use client' for interactivity; server components by default. Real-time: lib/pusher-server.ts (server), lib/pusher-client.ts + hooks/use-realtime.ts (client). Graceful degradation everywhere (Redis, Pusher, Email all optional).
directory_structure: Root: package.json, tsconfig.json, next.config.js, .env. Source: app/ (pages + API routes), components/ (UI), features/ (feature modules), lib/ (utilities), services/ (business logic), hooks/ (React hooks), validations/ (Zod schemas), types/ (TypeScript types). Database: prisma/ (schema + migrations). Tests: tests/ (unit), tests/integration/ (integration). Docs: docs/, README.md, IMPLEMENTATION_ROADMAP.md.
